name: openspec-sync-specs
description: Syncs a change's delta specs into the long-lived main specs under openspec/specs/, without archiving the change. Use for "sync specs for <change>", "update main specs with these changes", or as a step inside openspec-archive-change/openspec-bulk-archive-change. This is agent-driven intelligent merging (partial updates, not wholesale replacement) — not a mechanical diff apply.
